reviews.t:
We had an absolutely fantastic time on the North Marais food and wine tour with Lamine from Paris by Mouth. From start to finish, the experience was thoughtful, generous, and incredibly delicious.

Lamine is an outstanding guide and sommelier — knowledgeable without ever feeling intimidating, passionate, and genuinely warm. He did a wonderful job weaving together food, wine, history, and neighborhood context, making each stop feel meaningful rather than rushed. His wine selections were excellent and thoughtfully paired, and his explanations made even complex details feel accessible and fun.

The tastings themselves were exceptional: perfectly crusty baguette and viennoiserie, elegant chocolates, flavorful charcuterie, a truly memorable lineup of cheeses, and beautifully chosen French wines. The variety was impressive, and everything felt high‑quality and well curated. We walked away full, happy, and inspired to revisit several of the shops.

Beyond the food, the tour felt very personal — Lamine was attentive, engaging, and happy to answer questions, whether about wine, Paris food culture, or where to eat afterward. We loved ending the tour with his thoughtful restaurant and neighborhood recommendations.

If you’re looking for an authentic, delicious way to experience Paris — especially if you love food and wine — I can’t recommend this tour (and Lamine) enough. A true highlight of our trip.
